Poster. A poster layout with the bottle intact and the headline legible.
Packshot. Centered bottle, clean gradient, nothing else in frame.
Macroshot Scene. Macro look with droplets; the label still readable.
Macroshot Product. A tight detail of the bottle, not the whole bottle.
Giant Product. Convincing scale: the bottle towers over buildings.
Billboard Ad. The portrait appears on the billboard, not as the whole image.
Graffiti Ad. A mural of the sneaker with graffiti texture.
Fridge Ad. Fridge interior with the bottle on a shelf.
Marketing (UGC). A hand holding the bottle; snapshot look, not studio.
AI Headshot Generator. Same face, studio light, blazer; shoulders-up.
Commercial Faces. Campaign look with his face unchanged.
Style Snap. Full-length, new outfit, same face.
Skin Enhancer. Subtle: compare with the input; pores still visible.
Outfit Vending Machine. Red jacket, jeans and sneakers as vending items.
Glitter Sticker. Sticker look: white border, holographic sparkle.
Game Dump. Cel-shaded render with his features.
Plushies. A plush duck with seams and embroidered eyes.
3D Render. 3D look, recognizable features.
3D Figure. Figure in packaging, same outfit.
Pixel Game. Visible pixels, HUD at the top.
Brick Cube. A brick-built red car with studs.
Sketch-to-Real. A real cat on a real windowsill, same layout as the sketch.
Paint App. Crude flat drawing with a toolbar.
Signboard. Painted wall with his face, street below.
Surrounded by Animals. Small animals on her shoulders; same face.
